title: From $2.46 Billion to $4 Trillion
description:
In 1997, all of Apple was worth 2.46 billion dollars. Today it's worth over 4 trillion.

Sources:
- Wikipedia: History of Apple Inc.: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/History_of_Apple_Inc.
- Wikipedia: Apple Inc.: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Apple_Inc.

From Wikipedia (History of Apple Inc.): Steve Jobs returned to Apple in 1997 after it bought his company NeXT and became interim CEO; at the August 1997 Macworld Expo he announced a partnership with Microsoft including a US$150 million investment in Apple; the day before, Apple had a market cap of $2.46 billion; the first iMac was unveiled May 6, 1998 and sold about 800,000 units in its first five months; the iPod arrived in 2001 and the iPhone on June 29, 2007. From Wikipedia (Apple Inc.): on August 2, 2018 Apple became the first publicly traded US company worth $1 trillion, and as of October 2025 it was valued at just over $4 trillion. Photos: Wikimedia Commons (credits below). Not financial advice.
